meta_description:
1,965 likes, 29 comments - daveramsey on October 30, 2026: "Spending, saving, and giving are the three money skills everyone needs to learn.

Spending is learning to enjoy life with your money.

Saving is putting money aside for emergencies, college, and retirement to build wealth.

Giving is using the power of generosity to change who you are because giving is the most fun you will ever have with money.".
